product_one_liner.value: Druid AI is an enterprise platform for building and orchestrating AI agents that automate customer and employee workflows across chat, SMS, voice and email while connecting to existing business systems.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes tailored pricing plans and enterprise offerings; a quote is required rather than a published dollar price.

named_customers.notes: All three appear in the company's customer-story section.

employee_band.notes: Based on a November 2026 third-party estimate of approximately 216 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The visible index contains enterprise-AI guidance, product content and customer use cases, rather than two identifiable engineer-authored posts explaining how Druid itself is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes guides for building AI agents, creating flows, integrations and configuring generative endpoints.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers page lists Technical Consultant, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science role title.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Google Vertex AI; Mistral AI; AWS Bedrock; Mesolitica–MaLLaM; Druid-managed endpoints
model_provider.notes: These are documented supported generative-endpoint providers, not a claim that every deployment uses all of them.

compliance_certs.notes: Public security/compliance badges include SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR; these are company claims, not an independent audit assessment.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 16, 2025; the latest identified funding round.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 16, 2025 Series C falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A New York Account Executive advertisement has an active application option and a November 14, 2026 deadline.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 14, 2026, Druid announced new voice, agent-interoperability, governance and evaluation capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying, dated C-level or VP hire or departure could be verified within the window. An internal promotion was not treated as a company join.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Historical job ads name these systems in experience requirements; Outreach and Apollo are examples of outbound tools. Salesforce also appears as a supported integration. These signals do not establish current internal licenses.
